description: This file defines the 'LessThan' comparison operator class used within the OpenMRS logic operation package. It implements the ComparisonOperator interface and provides a string representation of the operator, meant for use in criteria or query building.

classes.name: LessThan
classes.description: A class representing the 'less than' comparison operator in the OpenMRS logic module. It implements the ComparisonOperator interface and overrides toString to provide a human-readable description.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string 'LESS THAN', representing the comparison operator.
